args.message: Q1 2025 revenue by region and month, counting all orders with no status filter. Each region's share is its fraction of that month's total across all regions. January's change is measured against December 2024 (North 3973.87, South 2896.61, East 2255.60, West 1122.23). The no-region group had no orders in Q1 2025, so it has no rows; its only order in the range I checked was 122.87 in December 2024. Shares were computed by hand, not by the query tool, and rounded to 6 decimals.
